description: Strict JSON output schema for a t3-cr-loop reviewer (single model) or merged council verdict. No prose is parsed.

summary.description: One concise paragraph summarizing the review.

verdict.description: "clean" only when the review is complete and findings is empty; otherwise "findings". Never "clean" for an incomplete review.

findings.description: One entry per bug CLASS (not per line).

reopens.description: Ledger class id (e.g. "C3") when this is an incomplete or regressed fix of that ledger class; empty string for a new class.

pattern.description: The root pattern and why it is wrong.

still_wrong.description: For a reopened class: what the previous fix missed. Empty string otherwise.

instances.description: EVERY instance in the reviewed scope, as file:line.

fix.description: The systematic fix that removes all instances in one pass.

prevent.description: How to prevent recurrence at the source: lint rule, source-guard / regression test, REVIEW.md entry.

sources.description: Allowed ONLY in merged council results (parsed with --allow-sources): list of contributing reviewer slots or provider/model tags.

merged_from.description: Merged council results ONLY (required when >= 2 valid slots): exact 0-based (slot, index) provenance entries from each contributing reviewer's canonical findings[].

merge_rationale.description: Merged council results ONLY (required non-empty when merged_from references >= 2 distinct slots): code-verified explanation of why the merged items share the same root cause.

step_back.description: Step-back rounds only (empty otherwise): one entry per recurring class.

sources.description: Allowed ONLY in merged council results.

merged_from.description: Merged council results ONLY (required when >= 2 valid slots): exact 0-based (slot, index) provenance entries from each contributing reviewer's canonical step_back[].

merge_rationale.description: Merged council results ONLY (required non-empty when merged_from references >= 2 distinct slots): why the merged proposals express the same structural change.

out_of_scope.description: Pre-existing issues outside this change; not counted.

sources.description: Allowed ONLY in merged council results.
